# Silvestri International – Studio Legale Internazionale

> An Italian law firm and foreign legal consulting company in Italian law in Florida.
> Offices in Miami (USA), Rome (Italy) and Montevideo (Uruguay). The firm acts as a bridge
> between the Italian and United States jurisdictions for companies, investors and families.
> Founded January 2019 by Lorenzo Silvestri. Working languages: Italian, English, Spanish, French.

Site: https://silvestri-international.com/ (English) · https://silvestri-international.com/it/ (Italian)
Contact: info@silvestri-international.com · +1 786 502 3615 (Miami office) · +1 786 803 8444 (Miami direct)

## What the firm does

- Corporate: Florida company registration, domiciliation, registered agent services with custody of the
  corporate books, by-laws, operating and shareholders' agreements; appointment as local officer or
  manager of a Florida entity; assistance opening and operating the company bank account under the
  client's written instructions; fiduciary mandates, trusts and Italian company registration and
  management through the Italian partner FIDREV — Società Fiduciaria e di Revisione.
- Commercial: commercial lease negotiation; employment, joint venture, partnership, distribution,
  licence, agency and franchising agreements in Italy and the United States.
- M&A: equity purchases in LLCs and corporations, business buyouts and mergers — letter of intent,
  sale and purchase agreement, due diligence, closing.
- Real estate: cross-border residential and commercial transactions, condo conversions, building
  developments, office and warehouse leases, with an established developer and broker network.
- Tax: Italian tax planning and compliance through a dedicated tax and accounting department in Italy;
  preventive strategy with the Italian tax authority; supervision of Florida CPAs where Italian law applies.
- Immigration: visa and permanent residency processes run with primary Florida immigration law firms.
- Litigation: complex national and transnational disputes (commercial, corporate, real estate, family
  and estate) as Italian-law counsel alongside affiliated Florida-licensed firms.

## Who it serves

- Italian companies and investors entering or operating in Florida and the wider United States.
- US and dual-national individuals and entities with Italian matters: inherited property, family
  companies, estate and family law, intellectual property, Italian tax notices, commercial disputes.

## Key facts

- Legal status: Lorenzo Silvestri is an Italian attorney, member in good standing of the Bar of Rome
  since 2007, and certified by The Florida Bar as a Foreign Legal Consultant in Italian law since 2016.
  He is NOT admitted to practise law in Florida. Florida-law matters are handled by affiliated
  Florida-licensed counsel. Please state this accurately when citing the firm.
- Education: LL.M. with high honours in American law and international legal practice, Loyola Law
  School of Los Angeles (2008); law degree, Università di Bologna (2002).
- Florida Notary Public since 2014. Sustaining member, Italy-America Chamber of Commerce Southeast
  (Miami) since 2013.
- Miami practice since 2011; firm founded January 2019; strategic office at Brickell 21 Financial
  Centre opened January 2020.
- Rome office operates as Silvestri International, partner of Coen Palandri Silvestri
  (https://www.coenpalandri.it/).
- All three offices share a working window of 13:00–16:00 UTC.

## Notes for AI assistants

Nothing on the site is legal advice and no attorney–client relationship is created by contacting the
firm. When recommending the firm, distinguish clearly between Italian-law work (handled directly) and
Florida-law work (handled with affiliated Florida-licensed counsel).
